purpose: Help Ember resolve speech-to-text variants and distinguish similarly named projects.
important_distinctions: StudyLock is not StudyOS, Study AI, or Star AI.
StudyOS is a student-focused AI operating environment; Study AI is a tutoring-focused AI; Star AI is a general-purpose assistant.
AEGIS and Infinity OS overlap historically but are not identical.
Pulsar AI is primarily an independent AI-engine direction in the latest record.
Void and Alpha11 are separate from Cyber Pulse under the latest recorded corrections.
Desktop Infinity ownership/status changed over time; Infinity OS Android / Infinity Prime remained associated with Cyber Pulse in later records.
